Farm-to-table gem!
May 2026 • Friends
Fresh, delicious, and downright friendly — this farm-to-table gem has become my go-to for healthy, satisfying meals any time of day. The menu is impressively wide-ranging, with something for every mood and appetite, and the staff goes above and beyond to customize dishes to my personal preferences. That kind of personal touch is rare, and it keeps me coming back. Highly recommend!

Lovely cafe but the food was average
Apr 2024 • Solo
Lovely staff and a very nice little cafe however the food didn’t blow me away. I got “the traditional “ breakfast with a smoothie. The smoothie was great but the breakfast was just ok. The sausage tasted like hot dogs and the potatoes were hard. I would give it another chance as the staff were very friendly.
